title: E2E.Test.Nested.Direct.7z.AES.Pair.2026.1080p-TESTGRP{{weaver-e2e-nested-inner}}
description: An LZMA2 7z with AES data encryption holding a stored 7z AES inner under a different password. The job carries the outer password and the NZB file name's braces the inner one, so each level opens only with its own candidate. AES over a compressing coder is a by-design direct-store refusal: the set demotes with 7z_encrypted_content and the conventional extraction opens both levels.
